title: THE SAMURAI - the oriental knight: the ability minima with the caste birth doctrine, the katana specialization, the ki and great kiai powers, the damage ladder, the jito and shugo stewardships, the bushido precepts and the ronin, Table 25
audit_comment: OA round ten (capture pp. 39-42): the samurai - the minima, the caste birth doctrine, the ki powers, the stewardships with the follower doctrines, the bushido precepts and the ronin

banner.title: THE SAMURAI, printed capture pp. 39-42 - the OA samurai round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 39-42 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). The Table 25 hit-points header is settled against the 2018 print (10-sided dice for accum. hit points) - the dice column pins as accumulated d10 with the printed 9-plus-N cells. The Table 25 grid itself sits as an extracted image in the first capture; the cells pin from the page-40 continuation with the 2018 print confirming every cell. OCR normalization: 2d level reads as 2nd level; a fitting homes reads as a fitting home; Stunned character cannot reads as the stunned cannot (prose only)

bools.name: dgjSamuraiRoninReturnable

tables.name: dgjT25Grid
tables.comment: the Table 25 samurai advancement grid (capture pp. 39-40)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 2,500 at 1st to 1,300,000 at 12th (capture pp. 39-40).
the accumulated d10 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 (capture pp. 39-40).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 2 hp per level beyond 10th: 0 through 9th, then 2, 4, 6 (capture pp. 39-40).
the damage bonus column: 0 at 1st, +1 from 2nd, +2 from 5th, +3 from 8th, +4 from 11th (capture pp. 39-40).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 25 grid: the xp bounds, the accumulated dice plus bonus and the damage ladder (capture pp. 39-40)
